all-approved: Every served tool and the instructions match the lock.
stdio-package-approved: Stdio server identified by its npm coordinate.
command-args-approved: Stdio server in the command form, args included.
command-args-differ: Same command, other args: another identity, so the server is unlocked.
identity-command-without-args: Command identity in the earlier two-member form.
identity-args-secret: Shard identity whose args hold a credential.
digest-non-ascii-digit: Approved digest ends in a non-ASCII digit.
digest-trailing-newline: Approved digest ends in a newline.
time-non-ascii-digit: Approval time has a non-ASCII digit.
new-tool: A served tool has no entry in the shard.
changed-tool: A served tool's digest differs from the approved one.
no-digest-tool: A served tool contains 2^53 and has no digest.
duplicate-name: Two served tools share a name; every copy is withheld.
unlocked-server: No shard for this identity; everything withheld.
monitor-unlocked-server: Unlocked server under monitor: shown, flagged.
removed-tool: An approved tool is absent from the listing; reported only.
monitor-shows-all: Monitor shows every tool and flags each reason.
strict-is-guard: strict behaves as guard in draft 1.
unknown-top-level-key: Shard carries a member draft 1 does not define.
unknown-tool-entry-field: Tool entry carries an unknown member.
duplicate-key-in-shard: Lock files with duplicate member names are unreadable.
contract-tampered: Contract bytes no longer hash to their filename.
contract-filename-mismatch: Entry points at a valid contract for another digest.
shard-h16-mismatch: Shard identity does not hash to the filename's h16.
symlinked-shard: Shard is a symlink (created from setup.json).
alias-command-traversal: aliases.json maps a name to a command path, not a basename.
aliases-ok: A well-formed aliases.json does not change the check.
unexpected-file: A file in .mcp/lock that the layout does not define.
manifest-ok: Manifest present, required by host config, and correct.
manifest-extra-file: A shard on disk is not listed in MANIFEST.json.
manifest-missing-file: MANIFEST.json lists a file that is not on disk.
manifest-hash-mismatch: A shard changed after MANIFEST.json was written.
manifest-required-missing: Host requires a manifest; none present.
signature-placeholder: Signer configured; the bundle is not valid.
sequence-rollback: Signer configured, test verifier accepts; sequence below the last accepted value.
signed-ok: Signer configured, test verifier accepts; sequence equal to the last accepted value.
signer-without-sequence-store: Signer configured but no sequence store: refused before any bundle is checked.
meta-approved: Served _meta matches metaDigest and is relayed; a tool approved with _meta may drop it.
meta-changed-guard: Served _meta differs from metaDigest; guard removes it.
meta-unapproved-guard: Served _meta, entry has no metaDigest; guard removes it.
meta-changed-monitor: Served _meta differs from metaDigest; monitor relays it and flags it.
meta-not-object: Served _meta is a string: it has no digest, so it changed.
meta-digest-malformed: A metaDigest that is not a digest.
session-listing-in-progress: Calls during a listing get no-listing; list_changed alone keeps the allow-list.
session-listing-failed: A failed listing refuses calls with unreachable until a listing completes.
session-stale-reload-shrinks: Default 60 s staleness: a reload withholds a revoked tool and never restores one.
session-stale-reload-fails: A failed reload is lock-stale; a whole-lock failure on a listing is reported before lock-stale.
session-dropped-answer: A dropped frame that answers a pending request ends it with an error; for the listing's tools/list the listing fails.
session-lock-broken-listing-fails: Call reason order: a whole-lock failure on the latest completed listing comes before unreachable from a later failed listing.
call-before-listing: Calls before any listing are refused.
calls: Calls to an approved, a withheld and an unlisted tool.
